description: Validate, lint, and fix GitHub Actions workflow and action files using actionlint and act.

evals.name: Validate a known-broken workflow
evals.prompt: Validate the workflow file at plugins/github-actions-kit/skills/github-actions-validator/examples/with-errors.yml and tell me what's wrong with it.
